sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #BUYER_ITEM_NO# AND SUBSTR(FILE_NAME,7,14) > SUBSTR(#FILE_NAME#,7,14)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT_CNT , NVL(SUM(ITEM_AMT), 0) AS TOT_AMT , COUNT(DECODE(IF_FLAG,'E','X',NULL)) AS ERR_CNT , COUNT(DECODE(STATUS,'D','D',NULL)) AS DEL_CNT FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND REVISION = #REVISION#

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = #LEGACY_PO_SEQ# AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #BUYER_ITEM_NO#
